info.description:
**Version 2.1** (2026-10-13)
- New step: attach one or more EXISTING L3Outs to the bridge domain of the CSV row (`l3out` = `L3OUT_A;L3OUT_B`, first one = contract side); works on new or existing BDs, already-attached L3Outs are left alone, skipped for L2-only BDs
- Pre-flight: every L3Out must exist and be in the BD's VRF; verification checks each association
- Rollback removes only the L3Out associations this collection added
- DHCP relay stays optional

**Version 2.0** (2026-10-12)
- vPCs only from the CSV `vpcs` column; existing L3Out / contract / monitoring policy only; DHCP relay optional (`dhcpMode`); VLAN + application profile created if missing; Postman only (NX-API, no SSH bridge)

# ACI UC3 - SVI migration from a Nexus (NX-OS) vPC pair with HSRP + DHCP relay to Cisco ACI

Moves the default gateway of a VLAN from an NX-OS vPC pair (SVI + HSRP + `ip dhcp relay`) to an ACI bridge domain, in phases, driven by a CSV (one row per VLAN). The Nexus side is read - and optionally shut - through **NX-API** (`feature nxapi`), so the HSRP VIP, prefix, virtual MAC and DHCP servers never have to be typed.

| Phase (`phase` column) | What happens |
|---|---|
| `extend` | VLAN pool block, BD **L2 only** (no routing, ARP + unknown-unicast flooding), EPG, physical domain, static bindings to the **legacy vPC towards the Nexus pair** (matched by `legacyMatch`) and to the ACI host vPCs / ports (trunk or access). HSRP on NX-OS stays the gateway. Hosts can be moved to ACI ports. |
| `cutover` | Reads both switches (00.4/00.5), consolidates (00.6), pre-flight (duplicate subnet in VRF, DHCP providers, L3Out VRF, Nexus SVI state), then in the change window: DHCP relay policies (03.8) -> `shutdown` SVI on the **standby** (03.9a) then the **active** switch (03.9b) -> **one atomic POST** (03.10): BD routing on, **BD MAC = HSRP virtual MAC** (hosts keep their ARP entry), HSRP VIP(s) as BD gateway subnets, DHCP labels, L3Out association. Verification 04.6 re-reads the Nexus SVIs and the BD. |
| `all` | `extend` + `cutover` in one run. |
| `new` | **Brand-new SVI on ACI** (no Nexus involved, `nxosA/B` not needed): L2 objects + bindings, then the ACI anycast gateway from `gatewaySubnets` (optional `gatewayMac`, DHCP relay from `dhcpRelayServers`), BD associated to `l3out` and advertised (`subnetScope=public`). |
| `cleanup` | After every host left the Nexus side: removes the legacy vPC binding and switches the BD to hardware proxy / no ARP flooding. |

**vPCs from the CSV:** only the EXISTING vPC policy groups listed in `vpcs` are bound (leaf pair read from the APIC; an unknown name stops the run). The one matching `legacyMatch` is the vPC towards the Nexus pair. `hostPorts` adds single ports.

**Existing L3Out + monitoring only:** `l3out`, `l3outExtEpg`, `l3outContract` (tenant or common) and `monPolicy` (tenant or common) must already exist - the collection never creates or changes them. The EPG provides/consumes the contract (`l3outContractDir`); the external EPG is only modified if its side is missing and `l3outAttachContract=true`. The monitoring policy is applied to `monApplyTo`.

**DHCP relay is optional (`dhcpMode`):** `migrate` (default) re-creates the relay servers found on the Nexus SVI (or `dhcpRelayServers`) as ACI relay policies via `dhcpProvider`; `existing` only labels the BD with existing ACI relay policies (`dhcpRelayPolicy`); `none` configures no DHCP relay.

**Postman only:** the Nexus switches are reached through NX-API (HTTPS) from Postman itself; without NX-API use `nxosSource=csv`.

**Rollback** (folder 05, `rollbackConfirm=YES` in the environment): `rollbackScope=cutover` (default) reverts cleanup, removes the ACI gateway (subnets, labels, L3Out link, routing, original MAC) and runs `no shutdown` on the Nexus SVIs (active first) so HSRP takes over again; `rollbackScope=all` also removes the L2 extension. A per-row manifest guarantees only what this collection created is removed.

Not migrated automatically (reported as warnings by 00.4/00.5): HSRP authentication/tracking (not needed with the ACI anycast gateway), PIM/IGMP, ACLs, PBR, routing protocols on the SVI, IPv6, DHCP option 82 settings, MTU. The physical SVI IPs (e.g. .2/.3) disappear - anything pointing at them is listed.

## Environment
`apic`, `apicUser`, `apicPassword`, `apicLoginDomain`, `nxosUser`, `nxosPassword`, `rollbackConfirm`, `rollbackPreExisting`, `rollbackScope`. Everything else is in the CSV.

## No NX-API?
Set `nxosSource=csv` and fill `gatewaySubnets` (VIP/prefix list), `gatewayMac` (HSRP vMAC, e.g. 0000.0c9f.f032) and `dhcpRelayServers`; shut the SVIs yourself and set `nxosSviShutConfirmed=yes` in that row.

## Requirements
- Postman v10.19+ / v11 or Newman 6.1+, SSL verification off for self-signed APIC/NX-OS certificates.
- APIC 4.2+, NX-OS with `feature nxapi` reachable from where Postman runs.
- Select the **ACI UC3 - SVI Migration (credentials)** environment and the CSV data file.

## CLI
```
newman run ACI_UC3_SVI_Migration_NXOS.postman_collection.json -e ACI_UC3_SVI_Migration_NXOS.postman_environment.json -d ACI_UC3_SVI_Migration_NXOS_inputs.csv -k
newman run ... --folder "05 - Rollback (manual)" --env-var rollbackConfirm=YES
```
